quarterly_data.quarter: X-Fab press release: X-FAB breaks ground on new cleanroom in Erfurt (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: X-FAB broke ground on a new cleanroom at its Erfurt site (Fab4Micro project): X-FAB MEMS Foundry GmbH is expanding its manufacturing capacity for highly integrated microsystems and photonics, continuing the transition of the Erfurt site into the group's microsystems hub and creating a foundation for industrial-scale production of highly integrated microsystems and photonics solutions. The facility is intended to support growing demand from the automotive, industrial and medical end markets; the project is funded by the German federal government and the Free State of Thuringia under the EU Chips Act.
